headline_seed: Chunk of glacier blocks route up Everest in peak climbing season
description_seed: Sherpas cannot prepare the route to the world's highest peak because a huge block of ice is in the way.

what: Chunk of glacier blocks route up Everest in peak climbing season

clean_source_blocks.text: Sherpas cannot prepare the route to the world's highest peak because a huge block of ice is in the way.
A huge, unstable chunk of glacier is blocking the route up Mount Everest from Base Camp in Nepal just as peak climbing season gets under way in the Himalayas.

The Khumbu Icefall, a treacherous tumble of glacial ice and rock rising above Base Camp, is the first obstacle that climbers face on their way up Mount Everest. Every year, a team of specialized Nepali workers called the Icefall Doctors charts the route up the glacier that climbers, guides, and mountain workers use throughout the season.
Climbers in Nepal’s Mount Everest Base Camp are getting antsy this week as they await the official start to the spring climbing season.
